items.markdown:
If you’re looking for a **blue Staffordshire Bull Terrier (“Staffy”) puppy near Oxford**, I’d prioritise a breeder who can document health testing and lets you meet the mother and see where the puppies are raised, rather than choosing based mainly on colour.

The Kennel Club recognises **blue as a standard Staffordshire Bull Terrier colour**. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/breeds-a-to-z/breeds/terrier/staffordshire-bull-terrier/?gad=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com) 

### Where to look near Oxford

I found several Staffy breeders in the broader Oxford/southern England area, but I would **verify their current litter availability and health credentials before paying a deposit**:

- [Trojanbulls Staffordshire bull terrier licenced breeder and Champion stud dogs](https://www.trojanstaffuk.com/) — Basingstoke, Hampshire.
- Turners Wood Kennels — Chalfont St Giles, Buckinghamshire.
- Brazen Kennels — Berkswell, Coventry.
- The **Kennel Club's Find a Puppy** service is also worth checking because it provides breeder contact details for registered puppies. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/breeds-a-to-z/breeds/terrier/staffordshire-bull-terrier/?gad=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I wouldn't treat a Google/business listing or a breeder calling themselves "licensed" as proof that they're a responsible breeder.

### What to ask the breeder

For a Staffy, I'd specifically ask:

1. **“Can I see the mother's health-test certificates, and the father's too?”**
 For this breed, The Kennel Club recommends testing for **L-2-HGA and hereditary cataracts (HC-HSF4)**, plus eye screening and elbow-dysplasia testing as part of its health recommendations. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/breeds-a-to-z/breeds/terrier/staffordshire-bull-terrier/?gad=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com) [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/media/cvef530x/kc_health_standard_07-25-web.pdf?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
2. **“What are the registered names and KC numbers of both parents?”**
 You can use those details to check recorded health results yourself rather than relying on a screenshot or verbal claim. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/dog-breeding/first-time-breeders/health-screening-a-step-by-step-guide/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
3. **“Can I see the puppies with their mother at your home?”**
 Ideally you should see the litter interacting with their mother and observe their living environment.
4. **“Have either side of the family had skin problems, L-2-HGA, cataracts, elbow problems or other significant health issues?”**
 The Kennel Club identifies **L-2-HGA and skin conditions** among the breed's current health priorities. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/breeds-a-to-z/breeds/terrier/staffordshire-bull-terrier/?gad=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
5. **“Why did you choose these two parents?”**
 A thoughtful breeder should be able to explain temperament, health, pedigree and genetic diversity—not simply say they wanted blue puppies.
6. **“How are the puppies being socialised?”**
 Ask about household noises, visitors, children, handling, other dogs, grooming, car travel and being left alone for short periods.
7. **“What exactly comes with the puppy?”**
 Ask about microchipping, vaccinations, worming, veterinary examination, KC registration, contract, food and insurance.
8. **“What happens if I can't keep the dog later?”**
 A responsible breeder should care about the dog's lifetime welfare and normally have a return/rehome policy.

### One important blue-Staffy warning

Don't let **“rare blue,” “exclusive colour,” or colour-focused marketing** persuade you to overlook health and temperament. Blue itself is a recognised Staffy colour, but the important question is **how the parents were selected and health-tested**. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/breeds-a-to-z/breeds/terrier/staffordshire-bull-terrier/?gad=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com) [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/breed-standards/colour-watch/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) 

Also be particularly wary of anyone offering **merle Staffies**. The Kennel Club says merle puppies are not registered because of associated vision/hearing health risks. [The Kennel Club](https://www.thekennelclub.org.uk/search/breeds-a-to-z/breeds/terrier/staffordshire-bull-terrier/?gad=1&utm_source=chatgpt.com) 

If you tell me roughly how far you're willing to travel from Oxford (e.g. **30, 60 or 100 miles**), I can search specifically for **currently advertised blue Staffy litters and breeders**, and separate the ones with verifiable health testing from the ones I'd approach cautiously.
